messages:
Morgan: Quick thread — post-launch routing hiccup. About 5% of requests are getting sent to a fallback model variant for certain header combos. Need decisions: bug hotfix vs shipping 3 small polish tasks this micro-sprint.
Pri: Flagged by two paying customers + internal alerts. Ticket ROUTE-401 has samples.
Keisha: Repro steps: requests with mixed-case X-Client-Type header get normalized incorrectly -> fallback route. Seems like a header normalization edge.
Lin: Fix paths: 1) input-normalizer guard in router (~1.5d) that blocks bad headers; 2) full routing middleware rewrite (~2w). Also we have three quickwins: metrics label cleanup (2h), search placeholder copy tweak (1h), onboarding tooltip tweak (3h).
DevX: Guard + quickwins is realistic this sprint. Guard is low-risk and can be canaried.
PM-Ryan: Customers expect a timely fix. Recommendation: prioritize the guard hotfix and the two smallest quickwins, schedule the rewrite as a follow-on epic.
Keisha: Hotfix acceptance: zero misrouted requests in canary for sampled traces + unit tests covering mixed-case and unicode header variants.
QA-Ricardo: I'll add regression tests and run canary smoke. Need a 24h observation window post-rollout.
Morgan: Vote: hotfix + metrics cleanup + placeholder copy now. Defer tooltip to next sprint. Owners: Keisha (hotfix), DevX (metrics), Lin (copy), QA-Ricardo. PM-Ryan will handle customer comms.
DevX: Opening PR branch `guard-hotfix/route-normalize` -> https://github.com/redwood/router/pull/632 (WIP).
SRE-bot: Canary scheduled for 2024-09-12T04:00Z for service "router-proxy". Rollback threshold: 0.2% misroute-rate.
QA-Ricardo: Canary smoke started after PR merge. Running replay against customer samples now.
QA-Ricardo: Good signal: misroute rate dropped from 0.05% -> 0.0% in first 12h. No perf regress observed.
PM-Ryan: Preparing customer note: mitigation shipped, longer-term rewrite tracked as epic "router-rewrite" with owner Keisha and estimate 8d.
Morgan: Backlog actions: create epic "router-rewrite" tagged follow-on, move tooltip ticket to next sprint, attach customer repro examples to ROUTE-401.
DevX: Merged to canary then promoted to prod in scheduled window.
SRE-bot: Production rollout started at 2024-09-13T10:00Z for service "router-proxy". Monitoring channels: #prod-router.
Morgan: Canary + prod stable, quickwins merged. Closing thread — hotfix applied, rewrite parked as follow-on. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
